residual.level: transition-conditioned command residual added to frozen deterministic controller

observation: 61 features: current/prior skill, nominal command, body velocity, angular velocity, gravity, height, local task errors/remaining goal, elapsed/window flag, phase, previous action, ideal-path error, joint position/velocity

reward.dense: per0.1s: -4*local_heading_rad^2 -4*local_lateral_m^2 for walk; -2*remaining_turn_rad^2 for turn; -2*speed^2 for stop; all -0.1*tilt_rad^2 -0.05*action_energy -0.02*action_change_energy
reward.terminal: +15 task success else -15; additional -50 physical failure; -10*sum(abs(local_heading_rad)+abs(walk_lateral_m))
reward.historical_envelopes: unchanged; reward is new training surrogate, not a replacement task gate

checkpoint_selection: fixed final checkpoint per seed; no evaluation-based selection
split: explicit distinct transition parameter combinations; nominal simulation seed alone is not unseen evaluation
evaluation: all declared held-out transitions, primitive regressions and two longer sequences; no tuning after observation
metric_scope: frozen local node envelopes plus separately reported ideal commanded path errors, physical stability, transition duration and reset counts

transition_recovery_diagnostic.role: new diagnostic only, never a task-success envelope; null means no sustained tracking recovery observed within window

negative_result_policy: retain failures, checkpoints, rewards, PPO diagnostics and every evaluation record; never alter old threshold or baseline
